verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows startup-adjacent work: an analysis of the 2026 Startup Notification, private equity and funds practices, and an ESOP tax publication. None of it mentions SAFEs, convertible notes or debentures, or a stated pre-seed or seed financing practice. Startup-recognition regulatory analysis and PE or VC fund work are adjacent topics and do not establish the convertible-instrument expertise this story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice
